# PDF image decoder fixtures

`pdfjs-bug-jpx.pdf` and `pdfjs-jpx-smask.pdf` are small JPEG-2000/JPX PDFs
from Mozilla's [PDF.js test corpus](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/master/test/pdfs).
They exercise the OpenJPEG WebAssembly decoder used by the Books reader.

The fixtures are retained solely as regression inputs and are covered by the
upstream PDF.js Apache-2.0 project license.
